correctness.rationale: For each even \(n\ge4\) the graph, dominance faces, V4 action and rational homology degree are defined. Thapper arXiv:0812.1165 Proposition 3.3 and Matsushita–Wakatsuki arXiv:2312.02639 suspension/Alexander duality imply a unique free homology group of rank \(n+1\) in degree \(n-1\). The signed simplicial trace reduces to a weighted invariant-face orbit count. Exact integer 4x4 and 16x16 transfer matrices satisfy \(T_s^4v_s=v_s\) and \((T_r^2-I)^2v_r=0\), respectively; with explicit initial values they imply every trace for every n. Independently enumerating faces and actions for n=2,4,6,8,10 and mod-two homology for n=2,4,6 reproduces all displayed cases. The exact infinite recurrences, not limited enumeration, support the universal character.

value.rationale: Known nonequivariant rank \(n+1\) cannot recover the four irreducible multiplicities. The theorem finds a precise mod-four change: the full symmetry quotient has rational reduced homology of rank \(n/2+1\) only when n divisible by four, and vanishes when n congruent to two. The exact finite-state method extends to infinitely many rungs with genuine nontrivial symmetry information, not a routine reparameterization or isolated numerical census.
